top_signals.title: Stocks Stand Pat as Brent Struggles for Direction: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks were steady as Brent crude struggled for direction after its longest losing streak this year, with traders waiting for the US and Iran to move closer to ending their war. The dollar hit the highest level since July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
